raw.description:
Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.

Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.

Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About the Role

Data isn't a support function at Vibe, it's the fuel. Every decision about which ad reaches which household, and when, runs on it. You'll join the Data Platform team and specialize in identity, turning billions of raw events into coherent, usable entities that power targeting, measurement, and the training sets Vibe's models learn from. You'll report to the Head of Data Platform. This role exists because identity resolution at Vibe's scale is a hard, unsolved problem, and the team needs someone who can build models that catch the right signal across petabytes of events. You'll get direct, measurable impact: your work decides which ad reaches whom and whether it worked, not a metric buried in a research paper. You'll shape the roadmap for a system every team at Vibe depends on, and work on a problem that only gets more interesting as CTV scales.

What You'll Do

Identity Stack Ownership

  • Research and build algorithms that resolve coherent entities, like users and households, from billions of events

  • Turn machine learning, clustering, and statistical approaches into scalable, production-ready systems

  • Lead projects end-to-end, from stakeholder requirements through research, implementation, and post-launch iteration

  • Build platform-level identity-resolution tooling so every team can resolve identity behind their own events

  • Design for scale from the start; treat unscalable local tests as unfinished work

Cross-Team Partnership

  • Help shape and execute the roadmap for Vibe's identity stack

  • Surface tradeoffs, risks, and decisions to stakeholders without burying them in implementation detail

  • Translate ambiguous requests from Product, Sales, ML, and Finance into concrete deliverables

  • Collaborate with other ML engineers on MLOps problems

What You Need

  • 5+ years of experience as an ML engineer or data scientist building and operating production services

  • Experience operating at data scale, using tools like Dagster, Spark, or Iceberg

  • Familiarity with MLOps tooling and practices

  • A track record of leading technical projects end-to-end, from ambiguous requirements to shipped systems

  • Strong cross-functional communication skills, including adjusting detail level for your audience and pushing back constructively

  • Judgment about when to invest in abstraction and when to keep things simple

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in streaming TV advertising or programmatic advertising

Our Values

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You'll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you'll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that's moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.

What We Offer

The pay range for this role is €99,000 - €171,000. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates.

At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we back that up:

  • Equity — Employee Stock Ownership Plan. You're building this; you should own part of it.

  • Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals.

  • Hybrid flexibility — We're in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week!

  • Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan.

  • Meal vouchers — Via Swile.

  • Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.

  • Tech Syncs — Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide.

Our Interview Process

We respect your time. Here's exactly what to expect — no surprises, no ghosting.

  1. Recruiter screen — 30 min. We'll share context; you'll share yours.

  2. Manager interview — Meet the person you'd work with directly.

  3. Technical Interview — A real problem, not a trick. We'll work through it together.

  4. Calibration interview — A senior leader joins to ensure we're holding a consistent, high bar.

  5. Offer — Fast. We don't let good decisions sit.

  6. Reference checks — Two calls, handled with discretion.

Equal Opportunity

  • Join a company in early breakout mode, already generating revenue, with a clear technological edge and strong financial backing to fuel its growth

Competitive salary + equity, disclosed during the interview process.

description: Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups. We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential. Help us take Wingtra’s new product platforms from fast prototypes to reliable series production. Embedded in the engineering team, you own mechanical design, qualification and industrialization through initial ramp-up. Together we deliver a qualified product, a complete product file and a working production line. We are early adopters of AI and actively build agentic workflows across engineering, from design and test planning to execution and analysis. Responsibilities Take a new aircraft from concept to series production. You work in a small team with electronics designers and test engineers. You get direct feedback from prototypes, flight tests and production builds. Design and iterate lightweight parts. You design, build and test parts and assemblies, then improve them until they are ready for production. Choose materials and processes with care. You balance performance, volumes, unit cost, tooling investment and lead times. Own DFX. title: Principal Java Engineer - Distributed Systems, Serverless - Elasticsearch
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.</p></div><h3><strong>What Is The Role:</strong></h3> <p>We are on the lookout for a <strong>Principal Software Engineer</strong><span style="margin: 0px; padding: 0px;"><strong> </strong></span>to join our <strong>Elasticsearch - Distributed Systems team </strong>and focus on how Elasticsearch provides scale, performance, and resilience, especially in the context of our Serverless offering. You will be tackling deep distributed systems challenges in how nodes in an Elasticsearch cluster communicate, and how data are indexed, allocated, and managed across nodes.&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>What You Will Be Doing:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Leveraging your deep distributed systems expertise to design, build, and operate core pieces of our next-generation Serverless Elasticsearch offering, directly impacting the experience of customers worldwide.</li> <li>Improving Elasticsearch’s components that support concurrent and consistent indexing across multiple machines.</li> <li>Maintaining our cluster coordination system to keep performance high even though nodes come and go from the cluster and data moves around, while maintaining the safety and liveness properties of the system as a whole.</li> <li>Pushing the limits on the number of shards, nodes, and petabytes that Elasticsearch can handle today.</li> <li>Looking into all kinds of issues, including performance or concurrency issues, and proposing solutions.</li> <li>Supporting our support engineers with the harder problems.</li> <li>Owning operational investigations end-to-end, until performance or stability issues are successfully resolved.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What You Bring:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You have a deep background in distributed systems and consensus algorithms.</li> <li>You have strong skills in core Java and are conversant in the standard library of data structures and concurrency constructs, as well as newer language features.</li> <li>You have a deep technical proficiency in algorithms.</li> <li>You have experience building large-scale distributed systems, rather than making use of off-the-shelf services.&nbsp;</li> <li>You have experience building and debugging complex features with a broad impact, running on multiple machines.</li> <li>You are able to own projects from beginning to end. This covers both technical design and working with others to develop needed components.</li> <li>You have experience managing projects involving multiple engineers.</li> <li>You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.</li> <li>You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities</li> <li>You can work autonomously, drive decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Bonus Points:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Data stores</li> <li>Search, analytics, Lucene</li> <li>Strong knowledge of the JDK</li> <li>Asynchronous event-driven network frameworks such as Netty</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People</strong></h2> <p>As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. 🍇 About grape: 
 
Our entrepreneurial spirit drives us in what we do and what we are passionate about. Our mission is to become the premier health partner in the insurance business. Recognising the need for innovation in the traditional employee insurance model we are set to revolutionize the employee insurance industry. We help companies support people before and after they get sick and to make more of their time. Our insurance solutions reduce monotonous and manual work for employees, doctors, HR & payroll managers. As we strive to lead a technology-driven transformation, we put employees first.
 
At grape we pride ourselves on our people and our culture. We continue to grow fast and that’s where you come in. Our team is dynamic, diverse and full of creative ideas. Want to join? We can’t wait to get to know you!

Your role

Our data and tech give us an edge in risk assessment, pricing and premium calculation. This role turns that into accurate models that support our carrier partners and our growth, builds tuned models where they beat rules and off-the-shelf LLMs in claims (triage, intervention, return-to-work, fraud), and responsibly explores how data can help employees stay healthy through grape Care.

We’re looking for an applied ML engineer / data scientist to build predictive models from the ground up on real, regulated insurance data. You’ll own problems end to end, from effective-dated records to production, in a domain where correctness and responsible use genuinely matter.

Starting points include pricing and risk, portfolio monitoring, claims and payment patterns, triage and return-to-work, absence, and fraud detection. grape sits on a rich dataset, though, and you’ll help find the next high-value use cases. You’re candid about what the data can support, and you propose simpler approaches when they’re the right answer.

This is not an LLM role. LLM and agent workflows and document extraction sit with our engineering teams, and you’ll use their outputs as features.


What you'll do:

Build and validate models

  • Own the full model lifecycle: feature engineering, training, evaluation, explainability, deployment, and drift monitoring.
  • Backtest on the historical book and run models in shadow mode alongside human decision-makers, reporting where and why they disagree.
  • Produce audit-ready validation and governance documentation that actuarial, compliance, and carrier partners can review.

    • Platform and MLOps

  • Deploy models on grape’s cloud platform within strict security and data-residency requirements for health data.
  • Set up experiment tracking, model versioning, and production monitoring, partnering with engineering on integration.

    • Shape the problem space

  • Identify and prioritize high-value use cases as you explore the dataset, rather than waiting to be handed problems.
  • Turn ambiguous business questions into well-defined, measurable modelling.

    • Responsible & explainable by design

  • Build privacy, fairness, and explainability into every model that touches personal or health data, working with compliance and legal on nDSG/GDPR boundaries.
  • Models support decisions; accountable owners make them. Pricing, reserving, and claims work requires licensed-actuary sign-off, and any automation requires governance approval first.

    • Collaborate

  • Explain model behavior and limits to underwriting, claims, actuarial, and compliance teams.

  • Strong applied ML and statistics: supervised and unsupervised learning, anomaly detection, time-series, and survival/duration modeling.
  • Proven experience building models on real-world, relational, effective-dated data, including imbalanced outcomes.
  • Fluent Python (pandas, scikit-learn, a modern ML stack) and strong SQL.
  • Solid grasp of validation, calibration, and explainability (e.g. SHAP).
  • Production MLOps: experiment tracking, versioning, and drift monitoring.
  • Sound judgment on data privacy and modelling.
  • Fluent English.
  • Bias for action, ownership, and clear cross-functional communication.

    • Big plus:
  • Insurance, actuarial, or risk modeling (pricing, reserving, loss ratios).
  • Health, disability, or absence data, especially Swiss insurance (KTG, UVG); fraud detection in claims.
  • Regulated special-category data under nDSG/GDPR, or model risk management.

title: Senior Backend & AI Engineer (Remote)
description: This role is open only to candidates living in the EU or EEA. We can't consider applications from other locations. If you've built something before, start here The hardest part of a startup usually isn't the code. It's finding customers who really need what you build and getting them to change how they work. At Scalera, that part is done: manufacturers, suppliers and contractors across Switzerland, Austria and Germany already run their tenders through us every day. What we need now are people who can take the next unsolved problem and turn it into a product customers can't do without. If you've founded a company (whether it worked out or not), been the first engineer somewhere, or built something people paid for, this role was written for you. About Scalera Scalera is an ETH Zurich spin-off building AI for the €200B+ European construction industry. Large manufacturers and suppliers still run their most document-heavy processes by hand, from reading 300-page tenders to retyping purchase orders into their ERP. We automate them one by one. Our product matching already handles 1,400 tender positions in 16 minutes at 98% precision, work that used to take a sales rep most of a day. What you'll do You'll be part product manager, part engineer. You'll spend real time with customers and help shape what we build. Sometimes you'll spot the next problem yourself, and sometimes we'll hand you a clear priority to run with. Spend real time with customers. Join calls and site visits, sit with the people who do the work, and understand why they do it the way they do. You'll know their problems firsthand, not from a ticket. Shape what to build. Turn what you hear into a clear problem, a scope and a plan, and push back when the obvious request isn't the real need. When we bring you a priority, you'll own how it gets solved. Build it. Design and build backend services in Go and Python that turn messy tenders, catalogs and purchase orders into data customers can rely on. Ship, then check. Get it in front of customers fast, watch how they actually use it, and iterate. Own it in production. When something breaks at a customer, it's yours to understand and fix. Build with AI. Use AI heavily in how you work, and design systems that agents can use as well as people. What success looks like after 3 months There's a part of the product people now think of as yours, and you're the one deciding what happens to it next You've spotted a problem nobody asked you to solve, made the case for it, and shipped a first version You've shipped features from both sources: priorities we set and ideas from your own customer conversations At least once, you've talked us out of building something customers didn't really need You've left a part of the platform simpler than you found it You'll probably thrive here if You've taken something from zero to one: a company, a product line, or a side project with paying users You've built and run backend systems in production that other people depend on. raw.description:
This role is open only to candidates living in the EU or EEA. We can't consider applications from other locations.

If you've built something before, start here

The hardest part of a startup usually isn't the code. It's finding customers who really need what you build and getting them to change how they work. At Scalera, that part is done: manufacturers, suppliers and contractors across Switzerland, Austria and Germany already run their tenders through us every day.

What we need now are people who can take the next unsolved problem and turn it into a product customers can't do without. If you've founded a company (whether it worked out or not), been the first engineer somewhere, or built something people paid for, this role was written for you.

About Scalera

Scalera is an ETH Zurich spin-off building AI for the €200B+ European construction industry. Large manufacturers and suppliers still run their most document-heavy processes by hand, from reading 300-page tenders to retyping purchase orders into their ERP. We automate them one by one. Our product matching already handles 1,400 tender positions in 16 minutes at 98% precision, work that used to take a sales rep most of a day.

What you'll do

You'll be part product manager, part engineer. You'll spend real time with customers and help shape what we build. Sometimes you'll spot the next problem yourself, and sometimes we'll hand you a clear priority to run with.

  • Spend real time with customers. Join calls and site visits, sit with the people who do the work, and understand why they do it the way they do. You'll know their problems firsthand, not from a ticket.

  • Shape what to build. Turn what you hear into a clear problem, a scope and a plan, and push back when the obvious request isn't the real need. When we bring you a priority, you'll own how it gets solved.

  • Build it. Design and build backend services in Go and Python that turn messy tenders, catalogs and purchase orders into data customers can rely on.

  • Ship, then check. Get it in front of customers fast, watch how they actually use it, and iterate.

  • Own it in production. When something breaks at a customer, it's yours to understand and fix.

  • Build with AI. Use AI heavily in how you work, and design systems that agents can use as well as people.

What success looks like after 3 months

  • There's a part of the product people now think of as yours, and you're the one deciding what happens to it next

  • You've spotted a problem nobody asked you to solve, made the case for it, and shipped a first version

  • You've shipped features from both sources: priorities we set and ideas from your own customer conversations

  • At least once, you've talked us out of building something customers didn't really need

  • You've left a part of the platform simpler than you found it

You'll probably thrive here if

  • You've taken something from zero to one: a company, a product line, or a side project with paying users

  • You've built and run backend systems in production that other people depend on. We care more about your judgment than your language; you're strong in Go or Python and happy to work in both

  • You're solid on data modeling, API design and messy real-world data

  • You'd rather talk to a customer than wait for a spec

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. You can make progress while the problem is still half-defined, which at a startup it usually is

  • You want a large scope of responsibility and are happy to own things well beyond your job title

  • Rapidly changing requirements don't throw you. When customers or priorities shift, you adapt and keep going

  • You enjoy direct customer contact and want to be on customer calls

  • You make things simpler over time, not more clever

  • You write clearly in English. German is a plus, not a requirement

You probably won't enjoy it if

  • You just want to code and go home

  • You don't like talking to customers, whether on calls or on the occasional site visit

  • Ambiguity and chaos bother you

  • You want a well-defined backlog handed to you

  • Your main goal is managing people soon. Here, scope grows with what you own, not with headcount

Our stack

Go and Python (FastAPI), PostgreSQL, GCP, and LLMs throughout the document pipeline. You don't need to know all of it on day one.

How we hire

  1. Screening call (30 min) with our VP Engineering. It's two-way: ask us anything, including the hard questions.

  2. Technical deep-dive call: walk us through something you built from scratch, the decisions you made and what went wrong.

  3. Meet Scalera Day: join us remotely to work on a real problem with real (anonymized) construction documents, and meet the team.

  4. Offer: if it's a fit on both sides, we'll move quickly to an offer.

Working at Scalera

  • Remote within the EU or EEA

  • Small team, no bureaucracy. You'll work directly with the CEO, CTO, VP Engineering and Customer Success

  • Competitive compensation

Founders and former founders: if you're unsure whether you fit, send a few lines about what you built and why you moved on. We read every one.

raw.title: Homologation & Certification Engineer, Energy Systems
raw.description:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

  • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

  • Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

  • Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

  • Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

  • Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope

The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

  • IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

     

Required qualifications

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

  • 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

  • Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110

  • Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

  • Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

  • Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

  • Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

  • Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

     

Preferred qualifications and personal profile

Nice to have

  • Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

  • Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

  • Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

  • Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

Personal profile

  • Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

  • Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

  • Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

  • Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end

     

Start date: Immediately

Du möchtest eine verantwortungsvolle Führungsposition übernehmen und sowohl Payroll und Arbeitsrecht als auch das Rechnungswesen aktiv steuern?

Unser Kunde ist ein etabliertes Unternehmen mit gewachsenen Strukturen und einem hohen Anspruch an professionelle Prozesse. Gesucht wird eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die HR, Payroll und Rechnungswesen verbindet und dabei sowohl operativ als auch strategisch Verantwortung übernimmt.

  • Flexibilität: Bis zu 2 Tage Homeoffice pro Woche auf Vollzeitbasis 

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Weiterentwicklung bestehender Prozesse und Strukturen 

  • Internationales Umfeld: Regelmäßiger Austausch mit internationalen Schnittstellen 

  • Perspektive: Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung und relevanten Fachbereichen inkls. Entscheidungskompetenz 

Deine Aufgaben als Teamleitung Payroll

In dieser Position verantwortest du die ordnungsgemäße und zukunftsorientierte Steuerung von HR, Payroll und Rechnungswesen.

  • Verantwortung für die monatliche Lohnabrechnung und alle damit verbundenen Abgaben und Meldungen 

  • Beratung von Führungskräften in arbeitsrechtlichen Fragestellungen

  • Unterstützung bei Controlling Themen und bereichsübergreifenden Projekten

title: Security Operations Engineer 80–100 % (m/w)
description: Sicherheit gewährleisten. Bedrohungen erkennen. Lösungen weiterentwickeln. Cyberangriffe erkennen, Sicherheitsvorfälle analysieren und Kundenumgebungen wirksam schützen, genau das motiviert dich? Du möchtest aktiv zur Cybersecurity beitragen, entwickelst Detection-Mechanismen und automatisierte Security-Prozesse weiter und behältst auch bei kritischen Incidents einen kühlen Kopf? Du hast Freude daran, Sicherheitsrisiken gezielt zu reduzieren und gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden nachhaltige Schutzmassnahmen umzusetzen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Wir suchen in Fehraltorf oder Aarau eine/n Security Operations Engineer 80–100 % (m/w/d) UPGREAT mit Hauptsitz in Fehraltorf und Niederlassungen in Bern sowie Aarau ist Dein kompetenter Partner für Outsourcing, Modern Work und Cloudlösungen. Unsere Unternehmenskultur basiert auf den drei Grundwerten: Begeisterung, Menschlichkeit und Kompetenz. Deine Aufgaben Betrieb & Weiterentwicklung: Du verantwortest den sicheren und stabilen Betrieb, das Monitoring sowie die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unseres Toolings, unserer Security-Services und der Kundenumgebungen. Security Incident Management: Du bearbeitest Security-Events, Incidents und Findings end-to-end – von der Triage und Analyse über Containment und Kundenkommunikation bis hin zum Post-Incident-Review und zur vollständigen Dokumentation. Detection Engineering & Automatisierung: Du entwickelst und optimierst Detection Use Cases, Playbooks und Automatisierungen und reduzierst False Positives nachhaltig, indem du deren Ursachen identifizierst und behebst. Vulnerability & Patch Management: Du steuerst das Vulnerability- und Patch-Management über mehrere Kundenumgebungen hinweg, insbesondere bei kritischen Schwachstellen und Zero-Day-Exploits. Dabei priorisierst du Massnahmen anhand von Exposition, Ausnutzbarkeit und Risiko. Security Services & Kundenberatung: Du erbringst rund 50 % deiner Tätigkeit als verrechenbare Security-Leistungen direkt beim Kunden. Dazu gehören Onboardings, Security-Baselines, Reviews, Reporting und die fachliche Beratung. Zusammenarbeit & Stellvertretung: Du arbeitest eng mit Operations, Engineering, KAM, CISO und externen Security-Partnern zusammen und stellst durch gegenseitige Stellvertretung einen zuverlässigen und kontinuierlichen Betrieb sicher. Kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Du leistest einen messbaren Beitrag zur Verkürzung der Erkennungs- und Reaktionszeiten (MTTD/MTTR), zur Erhöhung der Detection-Abdeckung sowie zur Standardisierung und Skalierung unserer Security-Services. Toolmaking: Du entwickelst Tools und Skripte, die manuelle Abläufe vereinfachen oder vollständig automatisieren und so zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer IT-Prozesse beitragen. Dein Profil Ausbildung & Erfahrung: Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Informatikausbildung EFZ/HF/FH oder gleichwertige Praxiserfahrung im System-, Cloud- oder Security Engineering und bringst mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung in SecOps, SOC/MDR, Incident Response oder Security Engineering mit, idealerweise im MSP- oder Kundenumfeld. Microsoft Security: Du hast fundierte Praxiserfahrung mit Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel und Entra ID und setzt KQL für Threat Hunting und die Entwicklung von Analytics Rules sicher ein. Security Operations: Du bist erfahren in Incident Response, EDR/XDR, Vulnerability Management sowie in der strukturierten Fallbearbeitung und sauberen Ticketdokumentation. Scripting & Automatisierung: Du automatisierst wiederkehrende Aufgaben mit PowerShell. Kenntnisse in Python, der Microsoft Graph API sowie in Logic Apps und SIEM-/SOAR-Lösungen sind von Vorteil. Ganzheitliches Systemverständnis: Du verstehst die Zusammenhänge und Abhängigkeiten zwischen Identitäten, Endpoints, Netzwerken, Cloud, Backup, Applikationen und Betriebsprozessen und behältst auch in komplexen Umgebungen den Überblick. Analytische Stärke: Du gehst technische Herausforderungen ruhig, methodisch und lösungsorientiert an und triffst auch unter Zeitdruck sowie bei unvollständiger Informationslage fundierte Entscheidungen. Kommunikation & Kundenorientierung: Du kommunizierst sicher und adressatengerecht auf Deutsch und verfügst über gute Englischkenntnisse. Dabei gelingt es dir, technische Sachverhalte sowohl für Fachpersonen als auch für das Management verständlich aufzubereiten. Weiterentwicklung & Zertifizierungen: Du bist motiviert, dein Security-Know-how laufend weiterzuentwickeln. Zertifizierungen wie SC-200, SC-300, AZ-500, Security+ oder GIAC sind willkommen. Den Erwerb der Zertifizierung SC-200 innerhalb von zwölf Monaten unterstützen wir aktiv. Deine Perspektiven bei der UPGREAT: Du wirst Teil eines dynamischen, kollegialen Teams mit über 150 Mitarbeitenden, hier zählt Zusammenarbeit genauso wie individuelle Stärken. Dich erwartet ein spannendes Wirkungsfeld mit viel Gestaltungsfreiraum, Verantwortung übernehmen gehört bei uns dazu. Du arbeitest in modernen Büroräumlichkeiten mit ergonomisch ausgestatteten Arbeitsplätzen. Deine soziale Absicherung ist uns wichtig, wir übernehmen 55 % deines Pensionskassenbeitrags sowie den Beitrag zur Krankentaggeldversicherung. Deine Entwicklung liegt uns am Herzen, wir fördern deine Weiterbildung und begleiten dich auf deinem beruflichen Weg. Deine Leistung schätzen wir, mit attraktiven Fringe Benefits wie kostenlosen Parkplätzen, einem Geburtstagsgeschenk und Sonderkonditionen bei Fitnessstudios und weiteren Partnern. Interessiert den Weg mit uns zu gehen? Überzeugt, dass Du bei uns richtig bist? Dann sende uns doch Deine Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf, Zeugnissen & allfälligen Zertifikaten. WICHTIG: Für diese Stelle akzeptieren wir nur Direktbewerbungen. Dossiers von Personalvermittlern können wie Direktbewerbungen behandelt werden, ohne Anspruch auf Honorar. title: Offensive Security Engineer
description: <blockquote>Shape our offensive security services</blockquote> <p>Ready to immerse yourself in the world of securing critical IT by thinking and acting like a real adversary? Join our security team at Schuberg Philis! We are an engineering company with a people-centric approach and a focus on customer satisfaction, dedicated to delivering mission critical IT solutions to our customers.<br><br>As an offensive security specialist, you will collaborate with about 30 customer-oriented teams managing critical system environments. Your role is pivotal in ensuring the security of Schuberg Philis and its customers by identifying and exploiting realistic paths in our complex, one-of-a-kind environments. You will scope, execute, and report on penetration tests, purple and red teaming engagements, and threat modeling assessments tailored to our unique and complex mission-critical environments. We focus on what real-world adversaries search for and abuse, not compliance-driven checks that look good on paper but don't raise resilience.<br><br>You will engage closely with engineers, customer teams, external experts, vendors, and stakeholders to define and drive work that measurably strengthens these environments. The engagements are hands-on and technical, and we want someone who can own an engagement end-to-end: from a customer saying "we want to test something, can you help us figure out what?" all the way to presenting the results of a bespoke engagement to their board.<br><br>At Schuberg Philis, we thrive on growth and innovation, offering an exciting environment for security enthusiasts. We are actively seeking security professionals at various seniority levels to join our security team. We provide a challenging and rewarding atmosphere where autonomy in your day-to-day operations is valued.</p> <p>We are a small team and we are part of the team that works on our value propositions for security. This means we have a lot of mandate to define and shape offensive security services within Schuberg Philis. <br><br>In this role, you will work with cutting-edge technologies, spanning private and public clouds and VMs to serverless - all highly automated. As an offensive security specialist your skills will be put to the test in a diverse technological landscape.<br><br></p> <p><strong>Success in this role requires a unique blend of skills and traits</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years of experience (the more the better) in an offensive security role.</li> <li>A security mindset aimed at identifying realistic attack paths from a real-world adversaries' perspective.</li> <li>Giving security advice that fits the unique and challenging mission-critical environments we manage to help our teams set up strong defense-in-depth. Recommendations should fit the environment in front of you, not a textbook fix that can't be applied there.</li> <li>You will have the experience and judgment to run engagements on your own, and the collaborative instinct to tackle the hardest problems together. Our teams will love you if you can take them by the hand through the entire process.</li> <li>Experience and understanding at least one of the major clouds (AWS, Azure, GCP).</li> <li>Strong risk management thinking, sense of ownership, and a solid BS radar.</li> <li>Eagerness to learn, coupled with a stubborn determination to make things happen.</li> <li>Experience with building solid tools that support our activities.</li> <li>Experience in IT engineering and IT engineering heavy environments preferred.</li> </ul> <p><br><strong>What will be your focus?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Help scope, lead, execute, and report on various types of complex offensive security engagements. Every environment is unique, and we expect our engagements to treat them as such as well.</li> <li>Build and maintain tools to help scale our offensive security services well beyond a small team. As an example: by building and maintaining a secure AI penetration testing methodology and toolkit that can be used by our customer teams.</li> <li>Collaborating with all customer teams, offering guidance on security-related topics.</li> <li>Evaluating and improving the security resilience of Schuberg Philis itself through red and purple teaming engagements.</li> <li>Using your technical and soft skills to guide the organization in adopting security measures along with the broader security team. We show impact, and can help limit it.</li> </ul> <p><br><strong>Where we would love to grow as a team</strong><br>We care more about mindset, experience, and being calm under pressure than a checklist of specific technologies. Our best work comes from people who can rely on experience and the right mindset to tackle the unfamiliar. However, if you bring depth in advanced malware development, Kubernetes, or OT security, you'll find eager sparring partners and plenty of room to make those areas your own.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>Everyone we work with and consider working with has a right to equal treatment. The hiring and appraisal process at Schuberg Philis is designed to be thorough and equitable, implementing fair payment, benefits, and opportunities across all demographics.&nbsp;</em><br><em>&nbsp;</em><br><em>It is our desire to be a company that brings together multiple nationalities, cultures, religions, genders, abilities, and talents within and across our teams. We welcome colleagues from diverse backgrounds to join Schuberg Philis and actively support diversity and inclusion in the tech industry.</em></p></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Customer Service Agent
description: Bij Crisp staan onze klanten op nummer één. Ons gezellige en hechte serviceteam doet er alles aan om die klanten van de beste service te voorzien. We hebben daarom veel persoonlijk contact met de klant, en ondersteunen onze bezorgers voor een vlekkeloze bezorging. We zijn nog volop in ontwikkeling, dus je denkt ook mee over hoe we onze service kunnen verbeteren. Wat je gaat doen Je hebt elke dag direct contact met onze klanten, vooral via Whatsapp. Zo maak je ze nog blijer nadat ze ons gesproken hebben. Daarnaast geef je feedback van klanten door aan de juiste teams binnen Crisp, zodat we onze service kunnen blijven verbeteren. Ook zorg je samen met onze bezorgers en je collega's op onze logistieke hubs dat bezorgingen vlekkeloos verlopen. Verder verdiep je je in onze processen. Zoals je al hoort, geen dag is hetzelfde! Hoe ziet een werkdag eruit? 's Ochtends hou je onze bezorgroutes goed in de gaten. Is het druk op de weg? Dan zorg jij ervoor dat onze klanten op tijd weten dat hun bezorger iets later is. Ondertussen pak je WhatsApp-berichtjes van klanten op. Je helpt ze met het aanpassen van hun bestelling, het kiezen van een bezorgtijd of beantwoordt vragen over ons assortiment. Zo leer je elke dag iets nieuws over eten! Lunchtijd! Elke dag lunchen we met onze eigen boodschappen. Een ideaal moment om ons assortiment én je collega's beter te leren kennen. Na de lunch beantwoord je vragen via WhatsApp, social media en e-mail, terwijl je collega's de bezorgingen in de gaten houden of bezig zijn met de processen. Je merkt dat er veel vragen zijn over een bepaalde marketingactie. Dat geef je dus meteen even door aan de juiste collega. De collega's die 's avonds werken nemen jouw taken over. Dat zorgt ervoor dat je de feedback die klanten doorgeven via de app nog even kunt verwerken. Tijd om af te sluiten. Samen met je collega's drink je nog een ijskoud Crisp-drankje in onze gezellige keuken. Dit ben jij Je herkent je in het volgende profiel: Je bent parttime (16-24 uur per week) beschikbaar. We zijn 7 dagen per week open van 07:30 tot 23:00 uur, en je werkt straks in shifts van 4 tot 8 uur. Daarom is flexibele beschikbaarheid voor overdag, avonden én in het weekend een must. Je woont in omgeving Amsterdam en bent voor minimaal één jaar beschikbaar. Een kantoor in de Amsterdamse Pijp met een grote keuken waar flink wordt geluncht, gezellig gekookt en waar de kans op zelfgebakken taart of vegan roze koeken groot is. Goed om te weten: vanaf januari 2027 groeien we door en verhuizen we naar een gloednieuwe, grotere locatie in de buurt van Zaandam, Sloterdijk en de Houthavens, waar we vanaf dan onze nieuwe thuisbasis hebben. Je schrijft en spreekt vloeiend Nederlands. Op een persoonlijke en creatieve manier reageren op klanten gaat jou makkelijk af. Je bent oplossingsgericht en empathisch. Je kunt je verplaatsen in onze klanten en begrijpt wat er nodig is om hun ervaring met Crisp nog beter te maken. Je bedenkt creatieve oplossingen om onze klanten te verrassen en verwachtingen te overtreffen. Als je klantenservice-ervaring hebt binnen organisaties waar kwaliteit hoog in het vaandel staat, is dat super! Wat wij bieden Een marktconform salaris, afhankelijk van leeftijd. Een gezellig en hecht team. Veel verantwoordelijkheid, uitdagend werk en een dynamische omgeving. Een kijkje in de keuken van een snelgroeiende start-up. We zijn volop in ontwikkeling dus jouw ideeën tellen mee. Werken bij een B-Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op ons voedselsysteem en échte verandering teweeg te brengen Enthousiaste en ondernemende collega’s om mee te werken en te leren. Voor straks een perfect pensioen via BPFL. Voor nu een persoonlijk budget voor yoga, sport, mobiliteit en downtime via bijvoorbeeld ClassPass, Pathé en Blendle. Elke maand food for thought, met workshops en talks via de Crisp University. Tijd om je collega’s te leren kennen tijdens sport, events en proeverijen. Een kantoor in de Amsterdamse Pijp met een grote keuken waar flink wordt geluncht, gezellig gekookt en grote kans op zelfgebakken taart of vegan roze koeken. En... fikse korting op je Crisp boodschappen, omdat je thuis natuurlijk ook goed wilt eten. Ben jij geïnteresseerd? Is de functie van Service Agent jou op het lijf geschreven, solliciteer dan via onderstaand button. Hoe meer je kunt delen over jezelf en de reden dat je solliciteert, hoe beter. Bij Crisp streven we naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen welkom is, ongeacht hun achtergrond, geslacht, leeftijd, etniciteit, seksuele geaardheid, religie of beperking. Wij moedigen sollicitanten met diverse perspectieven en achtergronden aan om te solliciteren en geloven in gelijke kansen voor iedereen. We waarderen de unieke bijdragen die elke medewerker kan leveren en zijn vastbesloten om een inclusieve werkplek te creëren waarin iedereen wordt gerespecteerd en gewaardeerd. myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options.   

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem.

We are looking for an Account Manager, Capital based in Amsterdam to join our Financial Services team. In this role, you will partner directly with a dedicated portfolio of hospitality merchants, acting as a trusted advisor to help them scale and streamline their operations using Lightspeed Capital.

What You’ll Do

title: Director Go-to-Market and Revenue Strategy
description: Who We Are You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today. We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover. Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI. Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate. Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale. WHO YOU ARE You are a commercial leader who has built the go-to-market of a platform from a blank page and knows what it takes to turn a product that people already use into a business that pays for itself. You have priced and packaged products for marketplaces, brands or merchants, and you have seen the difference between a model that looks good in a spreadsheet and one that a small business owner actually adopts. You are comfortable in a B2B2C world: the customer is reached through someone else's channel, the data belongs to the ecosystem, and the money comes from several ends of a transaction at once. You influence without authority, because the teams that execute will rarely report to you. You are rigorous with numbers and plain with people, and you are at ease saying what the evidence shows even when the room expects something else. You want to build something that reaches millions of small businesses, you are prepared to work for it. THE OPPORTUNITY Toqan for Partners is the AI assistant for the merchants across the companies of the Prosus ecosystem: restaurants, pharmacies, hotels, sellers, real estate agencies and car dealers, five million businesses in total. It launched to restaurants on iFood in Brazil in September 2026 and reached 65,000 restaurants in four weeks with no media spend. The next twelve months decide how it will become a business: which applications partners pay for and at what price, how value is shared with everyone the partner transacts with, how the uplift is measured and published so the next company embeds, and how the product travels from iFood to the rest of the ecosystem and to India and Europe. You will lead that work, as the owner of the go-to-market and the revenue strategy of Toqan for Partners, alongside the product and technology leads who own what gets built. WHAT YOU’LL DO Own the commercial model Define pricing and packaging for the applications partners pay for, media management, supply, finance and operations, at a fraction of what they spend today and justified by the return they see. Design how Toqan takes part in the value it creates for the other end: take rate on agent-negotiated supply, credit origination, brand and industry media, and cross-sell of the ecosystem companies' own products. Set the rules that keep it honest, starting with the separation between paid placement and recommendation. Drive the rollout across the ecosystem With the Head of Operations, secure the commitment of each business in the ecosystem: sponsor, distribution, conditional yes and first market. Run the rollout inside each one, working through the teams that own the merchant relationship, and bring the product to its next verticals and markets. Build the measurement Own the scoreboard: active partners under a strict definition, uplift per business in retention and GMV, cost and value per active partner. Make the uplift the argument that brings the next company in and the evidence behind every pricing decision. Structure the partnerships that carry the revenue Lead the commercial agreements with distributors, industry, fintechs and the ecosystem companies' commercial platforms, from first conversation to signed terms, and the co-investment models that align their incentives with the partner's. Build and lead the team Hire and develop a small go-to-market and revenue team, growth on the merchant side, monetisation and analytics, and set its standard for rigour, ownership and candour. WHAT YOU BRING Ten or more years in go-to-market, revenue or commercial strategy, with at least one commercial function built from scratch and grown to scale. Hands-on experience with pricing and packaging, ideally for marketplaces, retail media, payments or SaaS sold to small businesses. Experience on more than one side of a marketplace: merchants or sellers, brands or suppliers, the platform itself. A track record of adoption at scale with a long tail of small customers, not only of large enterprise deals. Proven ability to move a result through teams that do not report to you, and to work inside another company's channel. Fluency with data: you build the business case, run the analysis and read the uplift yourself, and use AI tooling as a normal part of how you work. Candour, humility and patience: you say what the numbers say, you arrive to learn before you teach. English required; Portuguese or Spanish strongly preferred. WHAT WE OFFER Global impact: a product that reaches five million small businesses across Latin America, Europe and India. Ownership: the commercial model of a new business, with the numbers to be judged on and the autonomy to build it. Growth: exposure to the leadership of the group and of its companies, and a clear path into operating roles in the ecosystem. Competitive compensation and the Prosus benefits package for the location of the role. Why Prosus? At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next. Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing. Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page . Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have. Want to know more about life at Prosus? Explore our culture and values . Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

The next twelve months decide how it will become a business: which applications partners pay for and at what price, how value is shared with everyone the partner transacts with, how the uplift is measured and published so the next company embeds, and how the product travels from iFood to the rest of the ecosystem and to India and Europe. WHAT YOU’LL DO

Own the commercial model

Define pricing and packaging for the applications partners pay for, media management, supply, finance and operations, at a fraction of what they spend today and justified by the return they see. Design how Toqan takes part in the value it creates for the other end: take rate on agent-negotiated supply, credit origination, brand and industry media, and cross-sell of the ecosystem companies' own products. Set the rules that keep it honest, starting with the separation between paid placement and recommendation.

Drive the rollout across the ecosystem

With the Head of Operations, secure the commitment of each business in the ecosystem: sponsor, distribution, conditional yes and first market. Run the rollout inside each one, working through the teams that own the merchant relationship, and bring the product to its next verticals and markets.

Build the measurement

Own the scoreboard: active partners under a strict definition, uplift per business in retention and GMV, cost and value per active partner. Make the uplift the argument that brings the next company in and the evidence behind every pricing decision.

Structure the partnerships that carry the revenue

Lead the commercial agreements with distributors, industry, fintechs and the ecosystem companies' commercial platforms, from first conversation to signed terms, and the co-investment models that align their incentives with the partner's.

Build and lead the team

Hire and develop a small go-to-market and revenue team, growth on the merchant side, monetisation and analytics, and set its standard for rigour, ownership and candour.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Ten or more years in go-to-market, revenue or commercial strategy, with at least one commercial function built from scratch and grown to scale.

  • Hands-on experience with pricing and packaging, ideally for marketplaces, retail media, payments or SaaS sold to small businesses.

  • Experience on more than one side of a marketplace: merchants or sellers, brands or suppliers, the platform itself.

  • A track record of adoption at scale with a long tail of small customers, not only of large enterprise deals.

  • Proven ability to move a result through teams that do not report to you, and to work inside another company's channel.

  • Fluency with data: you build the business case, run the analysis and read the uplift yourself, and use AI tooling as a normal part of how you work.

  • Candour, humility and patience: you say what the numbers say, you arrive to learn before you teach.

  • English required; Portuguese or Spanish strongly preferred.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Global impact: a product that reaches five million small businesses across Latin America, Europe and India.

  • Ownership: the commercial model of a new business, with the numbers to be judged on and the autonomy to build it.

  • Growth: exposure to the leadership of the group and of its companies, and a clear path into operating roles in the ecosystem.

  • Competitive compensation and the Prosus benefits package for the location of the role.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Who we are</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. boundaries as we build for the future.</li> </ul> <p><strong>In this role you will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive revenue acquisition: Take ownership of net-new customer growth by generating 80-90% of your opportunity pipeline through outbound efforts.</li> <li>Expand key regional markets: Contribute to the growth of our mid-market segment across the Benelux region, leveraging expanding regional momentum.</li> <li>Leverage structured methodologies: Utilize professional sales frameworks such as MEDDPICC and Command the Message to effectively guide customer engagements.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Requirements for the role:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Sales background: Minimum. 18 months closing experience within a proactive SaaS outreach model, demonstrating independent PG/pipeline generation.</li> <li>Consistent quota achievement: Demonstrated performance exceeding targets within complex technology environments.</li> <li>Complex deal navigation: Ability to manage multi-stakeholder evaluations and technical proofs-of-concept effectively.</li> <li>Language proficiency: Native-level fluency in Dutch.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Advantageous:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Operational interest: Eagerness to discover how physical operations function across sectors to better address customer needs.</li> <li>Structured methodology: A disciplined sales practice focused on consistent activity execution to produce predictable results.</li> <li>Analytical focus: A data-informed mindset toward managing pipeline volume, discovery quality, and multi-threading for accurate forecasting.</li> <li>Adaptability and growth: A proactive focus on continuous learning, incorporating feedback, and refining tactics over time.</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div title: Stagiair(e) Digitale Transformatie & Publieke Innovatie
description: Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot Digitalisering verandert de manier waarop overheden en publieke organisaties werken, besluiten nemen en dienstverlening organiseren. Tegelijkertijd groeit de behoefte aan praktische oplossingen, toepasbare kennis en slimme instrumenten die organisaties helpen om complexe digitale vraagstukken beheersbaar te maken. Wil jij ervaring opdoen binnen een toonaangevend adviesbureau en bijdragen aan vraagstukken op het gebied van digitalisering, data, digitale autonomie en publieke innovatie? Dan is deze stage iets voor jou. Dit ga je doen Als stagiair(e) binnen het team Digitale Transformatie ondersteun je adviseurs bij uiteenlopende opdrachten voor ministeries, uitvoeringsorganisaties, provincies, gemeenten en andere maatschappelijke organisaties. Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit: Ondersteunen bij onderzoeken, analyses en adviesopdrachten. Voorbereiden en ondersteunen van workshops, werksessies en bijeenkomsten voor opdrachtgevers. Meewerken aan de ontwikkeling van praktische handreikingen, methodieken en kennisproducten. Uitwerken van onderzoeksresultaten naar concrete producten voor opdrachtgevers. Actualiseren en verrijken van onze website, publicaties en online kennisproducten. Structureren, actualiseren en verder ontwikkelen van bestaande kenniscollecties tot een deelbare kenniscatalogus. Uitvoeren van markt- en deskresearch naar ontwikkelingen op het gebied van digitalisering, data en digitale autonomie. Ondersteunen bij de doorontwikkeling van onze digitale-autonomie-quickscan en andere proposities. Afhankelijk van jouw interesses en achtergrond draai je bovendien mee in lopende adviesprojecten. Hier kom je terecht Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid vanaf dag één, krijg je de kans om te ontdekken wat je belangrijk vindt, waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen. Dit zijn je directe collega’s Je wordt onderdeel van het team Digitale Transformatie binnen de adviesgroep Openbaar Bestuur van Berenschot. Ons team ondersteunt organisaties bij vraagstukken rond digitale strategie, informatiehuishouding, digitale autonomie, datastrategie, cybersecurity en continuiteit, governance, dienstverlening en organisatieontwikkeling. Daarbij combineren we inhoudelijke kennis van technologie met inzicht in recht, bestuur, beleid en organisatie. Je werkt samen met adviseurs met uiteenlopende achtergronden, waaronder bestuurskunde, informatiemanagement, bedrijfskunde, data en technologie. Vanaf dag één krijg je verantwoordelijkheid en lever je een concrete bijdrage aan opdrachten en producten. Dit neem je mee Je volgt een hbo- of wo-opleiding op het snijvlak van data, digitalisering, IT en organisatievraagstukken, bijvoorbeeld informatiemanagement, business IT & management, digital business, data science & business, technische bedrijfskunde, bestuurskunde (met een focus op digitalisering), bedrijfskunde (met een focus op technologie of innovatie) of een vergelijkbare opleiding. Daarnaast: Heb je affiniteit met digitalisering en maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Ben je analytisch sterk en nieuwsgierig. Werk je zelfstandig en gestructureerd. Kun je complexe informatie helder opschrijven. Vind je het leuk om kennis te ontwikkelen én praktisch toepasbaar te maken. Dit bieden we jou Een meewerkstage van 4 tot 6 maanden. Startdatum januari/februari 2027. Een marktconforme stagevergoeding van € 600,- per maand (op fulltimebasis). Een laptop. Flexibele werkmogelijkheden, ook thuis. Persoonlijke begeleiding door een ervaren adviseur. Een stimulerende en leerzame werkomgeving waarin ruimte is voor eigen inbreng. De mogelijkheid om een netwerk op te bouwen binnen Berenschot en met bedrijven. De mogelijkheid om in te stromen in het traineeship van Berenschot. Stageplusprogramma Naast je stage kun je deelnemen aan het stageplusprogramma van Berenschot: een opleidingsprogramma van circa 3,5 maand dat trainingen biedt op het gebied van advieskennis, -vaardigheden en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Dit vraagt gemiddeld één dagdeel per twee weken. Via deze link lees je meer over het programma . Alles over ons stageplusprogramma | Berenschot Solliciteer meteen Spreekt deze stage je aan? Wacht niet langer en solliciteer! Neem contact op met Marielle Boer via WhatsApp (06 10 48 71 59) of per e-mail ----- voor informatie over de procedure. Vergeet in je motivatie niet te vermelden voor welke periode je een stage zoekt en hoeveel uur per week je beschikbaar bent. Dan kunnen we je sollicitatie zo goed mogelijk beoordelen. Zo ziet het sollicitatieproces eruit Na je sollicitatie ontvang je binnen een werkweek een reactie. Bij een positieve eerste indruk nodigen we je uit voor een kennismaking met collega-adviseurs en je toekomstige manager. Als dat goed aansluit, ontvang je een concreet aanbod. title: Data & AI Governance Consultant
description: Help organisaties om data en AI verantwoord, betrouwbaar en effectief in te zetten. Data- en AI-governance is meer dan beleid en procedures. Het zorgt ervoor dat organisaties grip krijgen op hun data, betere beslissingen nemen en AI op een verantwoorde manier kunnen inzetten. Bij adesso helpen we organisaties om datagedreven en AI-gedreven werken duurzaam te organiseren. Niet door alleen modellen en policies te introduceren, maar door governance te verbinden aan businesswaarde, adoptie en de dagelijkse praktijk. Als Data & AI Governance Consultant help jij klanten om structuur aan te brengen, eigenaarschap te organiseren en hun datamanagement en AI-governance verder te professionaliseren. Je vertaalt complexe vraagstukken naar praktische oplossingen die daadwerkelijk werken. Jouw rol Jij brengt structuur in complexe data- en AI-vraagstukken. Je helpt organisaties om hun governanceprocessen te verbeteren, verantwoordelijkheden helder te maken en data beter te benutten. Je werkt zelfstandig aan analyses, workshops en verbeterinitiatieven en schakelt daarbij met stakeholders uit business en IT. Samen met collega's en klanten vertaal je strategische doelstellingen naar concrete acties. Je krijgt de ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, je expertise te verdiepen en steeds meer zelfstandig klanten te adviseren. Wat je doet Data- en AI-governance Je adviseert klanten over data governance, datamanagement en verantwoord gebruik van AI. Je helpt bij het ontwerpen en implementeren van governance operating models, inclusief rollen, verantwoordelijkheden en besluitvorming. Je voert zelfstandig maturity assessments uit en vertaalt de resultaten naar concrete verbeteradviezen. Je ondersteunt bij het ontwikkelen van datastrategieën, governanceprincipes, policies en praktische roadmaps. Je helpt organisaties om data ownership en data stewardship goed in te richten. Data quality, metadata & AI Je analyseert en verbetert processen rondom datakwaliteit, metadata en data lineage. Je helpt bij het definiëren van kwaliteitsafspraken, KPI's en verantwoordelijkheden. Je werkt samen met data engineers, architecten en andere specialisten om governancevraagstukken te vertalen naar werkbare oplossingen. Je onderzoekt hoe AI en automatisering datamanagementprocessen kunnen verbeteren. Je houdt rekening met privacy, security, Responsible AI en relevante wet- en regelgeving, zoals de EU AI Act. Consultancy & stakeholdermanagement Je faciliteert workshops met business- en IT-stakeholders om behoeften, knelpunten en verbeterkansen in kaart te brengen. Je vertaalt zakelijke doelstellingen naar concrete governance-initiatieven en meetbare resultaten. Je presenteert analyses, bevindingen en aanbevelingen op een duidelijke en overtuigende manier. Je ondersteunt klanten bij het invoeren van nieuwe processen en werkwijzen en helpt draagvlak te creëren. Je signaleert kansen voor aanvullende dienstverlening en bespreekt deze met je team. Samenwerking & ontwikkeling Je neemt zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid voor onderdelen van klantprojecten en bewaakt de voortgang en kwaliteit van je werkzaamheden. Je werkt nauw samen met collega's uit verschillende disciplines en schakelt tijdig wanneer ondersteuning nodig is. Je gebruikt AI-tools waar ze waarde toevoegen en beoordeelt de uitkomsten kritisch, met aandacht voor vertrouwelijkheid en dataveiligheid. Je deelt kennis, begeleidt waar mogelijk minder ervaren collega's en draagt bij aan de ontwikkeling van onze dienstverlening. Wat jij meebrengt Je bent analytisch sterk, nieuwsgierig en weet complexe onderwerpen begrijpelijk te maken. Je vindt het leuk om met klanten samen te werken en krijgt energie van het verbeteren van processen en organisaties. Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in Bedrijfskunde, Informatiekunde, Informatica of een vergelijkbare richting. Minimaal 3 jaar relevante ervaring binnen data governance, datamanagement of dataconsultancy. Kennis van data governance, data quality, data stewardship en governanceprocessen. Ervaring met het uitvoeren van analyses, begeleiden van workshops of adviseren van stakeholders. Begrip van data-architectuur, datamodellering en de samenwerking tussen business en IT. Interesse in AI-governance en het verantwoord toepassen van AI binnen organisaties. Je gebruikt AI zelf in je werk en onderzoekt graag hoe het slimmer kan. Je werkt zelfstandig, neemt initiatief en weet wanneer je collega's moet betrekken. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om verschillende belangen samen te brengen. Een uitstekende beheersing van het Nederlands en Engels. Mooi meegenomen Ervaring met maturity assessments, governance operating models of het opstellen van RACI's. Kennis van DAMA-DMBOK of een CDMP-certificering, of de ambitie om deze te behalen. Ervaring met datacatalogustools zoals Microsoft Purview, Collibra of Alation. Kennis van metadata, data lineage en data quality frameworks. Kennis van Responsible AI, de EU AI Act of data-readiness voor AI. Over ons team Je komt terecht in een klein, enthousiast en leergierig team van drie collega's. De lijnen zijn kort, iedereen heeft invloed en ideeën worden niet alleen gehoord, maar ook uitgeprobeerd. Onze focus ligt op de consultancykant van data en AI. We begeleiden organisaties bij AI-transformaties en beginnen altijd bij het echte probleem van de klant. Van daaruit ontwikkelen we roadmaps en helpen we bij de implementatie. We werken aan data- en AI-governance, datastrategie, change management en datakwaliteit. Daarbij onderzoeken we continu hoe AI ons werk en dat van onze klanten slimmer kan maken. Ontwikkeling staat voorop. We delen kennis, proberen nieuwe werkwijzen uit en leren van elkaar. Heb je een andere achtergrond binnen datamanagement? Ook dan maken we graag kennis met je. Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen. Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt. We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen. AI First: samen bouwen aan de toekomst Bij adesso Nederland ontwikkelen we ons tot een AI First-organisatie. We geloven dat AI de manier waarop we software ontwikkelen, met data werken en klanten helpen fundamenteel verandert. Daarom kijken we verder dan losse AI-experimenten. We bouwen aan slimme dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die écht onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen. Dat betekent ook dat we onze eigen manier van werken blijven vernieuwen. We omarmen nieuwe technologie, maar blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop. En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren. Wat krijg je van ons? Een salaris van €5.400,- tot €6.600,- afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring; 8% vakantiegeld; Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week; Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding boven op je salaris; 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen; €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen; Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden; Goede pensioenregeling; Doorgroeimogelijkheden; Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team. Zullen we kennismaken? Je hoeft niet aan ieder technisch punt te voldoen. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke keuzes je hebt gemaakt en waar je naartoe wilt groeien. Een cv of LinkedIn-profiel is genoeg om het gesprek te starten. Daarna volgen een kennismaking, een technisch gesprek en een praktijkcase. Bij adesso werk je niet alleen aan de technologie van morgen. Je krijgt ook de ruimte om mee te bepalen hoe we die bouwen. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow
